summary: @ornikar/graphql-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex identifiers, rotated string-array lookup) and constructs a URL of the form https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<archive>.zip, downloads and extracts the Bun runtime, and then invokes bun via execFileSync on the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotated string array, XOR alphabet, hex-mangled identifiers) whose behavior is not auditable from source. The package's advertised purpose is a GraphQL config helper (the only bin is check-graphql-prod-compat.js) and has no functional need for the Bun runtime or a math-themed obfuscated bundle. Using a non-Node alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling at install time gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine while evading Node-based static analysis. The mismatch between the scoped package's advertised purpose and the shipped payload is consistent with a compromised publish of the @ornikar scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
